news.contents: New England Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown (ankle) was listed as a limited participant in practice on Wednesday's injury report, per Evan Lazar of Patriots.com. It's not clear whether Brown is dealing with a new ankle injury or simply managing lingering effects from the high-ankle sprain that he suffered in Week 1. Brown returned from that injury in Week 6 after missing four games. However, he's struggled upon his return, recording just six catches for 75 yards and zero touchdowns on 16 ...
news.title: A.J. Brown Limited in Practice on Wednesday with an Ankle Issue

news.analysis: The veteran played pretty well on Monday. He hauled in five passes over the course of the game and was able to turn that into 48 yards, but he didn't get into the end zone at all, which left him with a mediocre fantasy finish in most league formats. He will likely continue to be startable moving forward, especially if DeVonta Smith (hamstring) misses more time.
